---
title: "About this gallery"
---

What this site is for, who's in the group, and how to get in touch.

## Adding a project

1. Make a folder under `projects/` named after the project, with an `index.qmd`
   inside it. Copy the front matter from an existing one.
2. Fill in `title`, `description`, `author`, `date`, and `categories`. Those five
   fields are what the gallery sorts, searches, and filters on — a project with
   no `categories` won't appear under any topic tag.
3. Drop a `thumbnail.png` in the folder (roughly 3:2, 900px wide is plenty) and
   point `image:` at it.
4. Push to `main`. The site rebuilds itself.

If the project has no home here — it's a repo, a paper, or an app somewhere else
— add an entry to `projects/external.yml` instead of making a page.

## Category vocabulary

Keep this list short and shared, or the topic filter turns into noise. Current
tags:

| Tag | Use it for |
|-----|------------|
| Open data | Published, citable datasets |
